numerator.answer: 巴西居住客户的销售额。

denominator.answer: 分母是2023年全库的发票总销售额。

denominator_scope.answer: 用全库当年销售额做分母。

gold_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN c.country = 'Brazil' THEN i.total END) / NULLIF(SUM(i.total), 0) AS share FROM public.invoice i JOIN public.customer c ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE i.invoice_date >= DATE '2023-01-01' AND i.invoice_date < DATE '2024-01-01';

post_completion_turns.message: 分子换成德国居住客户的销售额。

post_completion_turns.message: 分母改成2023年账单国为德国的销售额。
post_completion_turns.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN c.country = 'Germany' THEN i.total END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN i.billing_country = 'Germany' THEN i.total END), 0) AS share FROM public.invoice i JOIN public.customer c ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE i.invoice_date >= DATE '2023-01-01' AND i.invoice_date < DATE '2024-01-01';
